# Answerfinch

> Answerfinch is a Google Forms™ add-on by Lazy Labs. You use it to email the right person when a form answer matches your rule. For example, email billing when someone requests a refund. Free plan: one rule at a time across your Google account, with every condition type. Pro: $4 a month or $29 a year, taxes included.

Answerfinch is not related to other products named Finch. It runs in Google Forms and is installed from the Google Workspace Marketplace.

## Product

- [Home](https://answerfinch.com/): what Answerfinch does, pricing and limits
- [Install from Google Workspace Marketplace](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/answerfinch_conditional_email_notificati/602427031339)
